reason: The plugin scans declared project build commands and exposes them as agent tools that can execute those commands through the shell, making automation its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 扫描项目中已声明的构建、测试和开发命令，并将其注册为可供智能体执行的工具。
summaries.en: Scans project-declared build, test, and development commands and registers them as tools the agent can execute.

capabilities: Scans Makefiles, package.json scripts, justfiles, and Deno task files
Registers one agent tool for each discovered project command
Executes registered commands through the platform shell
Captures command output and enforces execution timeouts
